newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shares end higher on speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shares end higher on speculative buying.

text.p: Jakarta shares edged higher by the close on Friday following active local speculative buying in selected second-liners, brokers said.
The composite index rose 0.72 points, or 0.13 percent, to 543.75. Advancers led losers by 50 to 41 and 50 issues unchanged.
"The local speculators certainly ran the show, but they failed to have much impact on the market as most of the heavyweights remained inactive," one broker said.
Brokers ascribed the lack of trading on heavyweight stocks to slow foreign participation ahead of the announcement later on Friday of United States employment data for August.
Local speculators snapped up heavy equipment distributor Intraco Penta and sent the second-liner soaring 275 rupiah to close at 1,500 rupiah on talk of a possible acquisition, brokers said.
Insurance firm Lippo Life ended down 25 rupiah at 1,950 rupiah after a day's low of 1,850 rupiah.
Lippo Life, Lippo Securities and Lippo Bank have been the focus of the market after news that the capital market supervisory agency was against the firms' plan for cross-holding of shares.

Hotel operator Bumi Modern ended 25 rupiah higher at 1,125 rupiah in active trading following reports that majority shareholder PT AJB Bumi Putera 1912 planned to sell its stake in the company through a tender offer.

Market heavyweight Telkom ended 25 rupiah higher at 3,300 rupiah despite worries many of the firm's employees were likely to sell their shares in November at the end of the lock-up period for their allotment.
